title: Session Capability State (radiation.session_capability_state/1) — S-2-ENV working memory
description: Working memory artifact persisted via radiation_pass --persist flag into Brain/short_term/active/session_capability_state.json. Schema radiation.session_capability_state/1. Fields: host_label DECLARED never discovered never profile-inferred, route as returned by radiation_pass.route(), capabilities[] {name, state AVAILABLE|UNAVAILABLE|UNKNOWN, provenance OBSERVED|DECLARED|INFERRED} vocabulary adopted per Gate-1 correspondence map, constraints[] {name, provenance, value_or_unknown}, generated_at ISO UTC, pass_ref, honesty_note. Mandatory discipline: UNKNOWN is first-class value everywhere; capability with no evidence is UNKNOWN never UNAVAILABLE; stale generated_at reads UNKNOWN rather than lie. File is session-local, presumed impermanent, triaged at session close per short-term law, never committed with live content. No hardcoded platform limits, no private-quota probing, no parallel EXECUTE/ALT/HOLD chain — input artifact consumed by scan/anchor/stockpile shortfall, never resolver. No autonomous self-check loop, no network calls from writer, file can never raise authority (data about limits, walls reading: stale reads UNKNOWN).

host_label.description: DECLARED — never discovered, never profile-inferred. The label passed via --host flag, as declared by operator.

route.description: As returned by radiation_pass.route() — provider routing decision

capabilities.description: Capabilities observed/declared/inferred this session — vocabulary adopted per Gate-1 correspondence map

name.description: Capability name, e.g. tool name, modality, or profile feature

state.description: AVAILABLE↔primary+active, UNAVAILABLE↔deprecated/secondary/asserted/benchmark, UNKNOWN↔draft+honesty-grammar per Domain-10 rider. UNKNOWN is first-class; absent evidence stays UNKNOWN never UNAVAILABLE.

provenance.description: OBSERVED must cite cap_probe execution this session in evidence field per checker discipline; DECLARED from host label or explicit declaration; INFERRED from secondary signals

evidence.description: Evidence citation for provenance — e.g. cap_probe execution reference, declared source, or inference chain

value_or_unknown.description: Value if known, or UNKNOWN string — UNKNOWN is first-class value everywhere

generated_at.description: ISO UTC timestamp of generation; stale generated_at reads UNKNOWN rather than lie per mandatory discipline

pass_ref.description: Reference to pass execution that produced this state — e.g. git HEAD, session id, or pass output hash

honesty_note.description: Honesty note: file is working memory, presumed impermanent, triaged at session close per short-term law; can never raise authority; stale reads UNKNOWN
